html:
Operation Barracuda was the French military operation of 20 and 21 September 1979 that overthrew Emperor Bokassa of the Central African Empire while he was visiting Libya.

The killing of schoolchildren in Bangui that spring, confirmed by an African inquiry, made Bokassa an embarrassment to France. French troops landed in Bangui with former president David Dacko, who declared the empire over and the republic restored.

No shots were needed. The operation showed how far France still controlled its former colonies, and Dacko was himself overthrown by the army two years later.
sum: Operation Barracuda was the French military operation of 20 and 21 September 1979 that overthrew Emperor Bokassa of the Central African Empire while he was visiting Libya.
